evidence_strength.note: The 88-work figure is a stronger-evidence subset, not an estimate of total A2 precision.

interpretation: A2 initially adds candidate-level coverage for 207 project works beyond R3+A1.
After applying known final labels and the frozen operational policy, 195 of those works retain at least one included A2 candidate.
Twelve A2-new works lose all A2 candidates after final disposition.
The 107 policy-accept-only works are operationally retained but do not have an individually adjudicated VALID candidate.
Work-level operational coverage must not be described as human-validated coverage.
